integrity: Finite group actions and chain ranks are exhaustively enumerated, two independent homology character methods agree, mathematical proof supplies the structural homology and quotient arguments; independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: A result for H(5,2) only. Integral homology ranks and full rational representations are proved; no integral Specht-lattice decomposition, generalized bipartite Kneser theorem, or equivariant homotopy type is asserted. The preexisting graph automorphism group and nonequivariant circle-wedge classification are credited. A logically equivalent older unindexed representation computation cannot be excluded.
title: The full symmetry representation of the Desargues neighborhood complex
